mines.name: LonRho Mine
mines.query: LonRho Gold Antimony Mine, Globe and Phoenix, Kwekwe, Zimbabwe
mines.summary: The LonRho mine is located within Kwekwe’s historic Globe & Phoenix complex. The mine has one shaft located 500 meters due-west of the historic John Bull shaft.
mines.intro: Situated in Kwekwe within the Globe & Phoenix complex. The shaft targets a network of gold and antimony reefs of this historic mining site. It currently produces 10 grams a tonne in gold and 35-45% SB for antimony. LonRho is currently on level 2 at 44 meters and promises to be our best producing shaft.
mines.caption: Material samples · AGANO image collection

mines.name: Anzac Antimony Mine
mines.location: Sebakwe block, north of Kwekwe, Midlands Province, Zimbabwe
mines.summary: An antimony project in the Sebakwe block, with reef development directed towards the main Jojo ore body.
mines.intro: Anzac is located north of Kwekwe in the Sebakwe block in Zimbabwe’s Midlands Province. This mine targets the Anzac reef which is part of the Jojo complex. The shaft is still under development with the objective of intersecting the main Jojo ore body at a target depth of 60 metres.
paragraphs: That target describes the intended next development outcome. Our focus is on strengthening the geological understanding, planning the work carefully and connecting mine development with the requirements of the processing route.
mines.caption: Shaft headgear at Anzac Antimony Mine · Sebakwe block, Zimbabwe

mines.name: Sherwood Block Gold Mine
mines.query: AGANO Sherwood Block Gold Mine, Zimbabwe
mines.summary: Underground reef development and open-cast mining within the Midlands greenstone belt.
mines.intro: This block is in the prominent, geologically significant mineral location situated within the central part of the Archean Midlands greenstone belt on the Zimbabwe Craton, positioning it along the historically prolific Sherwood Deformation Zone (SDZ). Operations utilize one primary deep-level shaft for targeted underground reef development alongside a high-volume open-cast mining operation to efficiently harvest the surface extensions of the continuous ore body.
mines.caption: Surface excavation · AGANO image collection

mines.name: Pagamesa mine
mines.summary: Nicknamed the Stronghold, Pagamesa mine connects the historic Fortuna, Pagamesa and Gothic reefs across four operating shafts—3 antimony and 1 gold.
mines.intro: Pagamesa mine works the historic Fortuna, Pagamesa and Gothic reefs through four operating shafts—three focused on antimony and one on gold. Reported ore grades are 32% stibnite and 10 grams of gold per tonne. These figures describe the mineral content of the ore; the amount recovered during processing depends on the ore’s characteristics and the efficiency of the recovery process.
mines.caption: Mine development · AGANO image collection

facility.name: Sebakwe Antimony Processing Plant
facility.verbatim_description: Located in Sebakwe, Kwekwe, our facility is designed to produce antimony concentrate. We source our feed ore from Pagamesa mine, Anzac & LonRho reefs. The processing streamline includes gravity concentration- Alkaline Leach- electro-winning- Smelting.

corporate_overview: AGANO Legacy Resources is a premier, independent Zimbabwean mining house specializing in the extraction and processing of high-grade gold and antimony assets. Driven by an elite team of 300 skilled mining and metallurgical professionals, our enterprise operates a highly resilient physical asset network across the historic Silobela-Gothic, Pagamesa mine and Fortuna complex, Sebakwe- Anzac bloc, and Globe&Phoenix LonRho reef, and the Great Dyke Sherwood mine. We manage the entire mineral value chain internally—from deep-level extraction to advanced processing—delivering premium, market-ready products to the global industrial market.
story: Our story is rooted in the rich earth of Zimbabwe’s historic gold and antimony belts. From the foundations of RIFA to the vision of AGANO Legacy Resources, our journey brings together respect for heritage, faith in Zimbabwean capability, and a commitment to building an enterprise that will endure across generations. That journey has demanded resilience. Taking responsibility for operations facing significant challenges brought a clear purpose: restore discipline, rebuild trust, and create a sustainable foundation for growth. We believe that mineral wealth carries a duty of stewardship. Every resource entrusted to us brings responsibilities—to the land, to the people who work it, and to the communities whose futures are connected to it. Our approach centres on strengthening operational governance, pursuing statutory compliance, improving environmental safeguards, and building fair and sustainable livelihoods for our mining teams. For us, legacy is measured in productive operations, trusted partnerships, dignified livelihoods and opportunities preserved for those who come after us. Our ambition is to contribute to Zimbabwe’s industrial capability while building wealth with purpose and passing on the principles that give it meaning.
minerals_narrative: Unlike traditional mining operations that discover companion minerals while chasing gold, our journey began with a definitive focus on antimony. It was through our dedicated work in mastering this critical, high-demand industrial metalloid that we subsequently uncovered our high-grade gold reef structures. This unique operational sequence has shaped our identity and gave us a deep, specialized expertise in complex base-metal processing.

Today, our primary corporate focus is on perfecting our craft in antimony processing. We are systematically investing in advanced differential technologies, optimizing our plant throughput, and scaling our extraction frameworks across the Sherwood Mine and associated reef networks. By refining our metallurgical recovery systems to the highest international standards, our clear ambition is to establish the enterprise as a top producer and processor of high-grade antimony in Zimbabwe, delivering an uncompromised, compliant, and strategic supply chain to the global industrial market.
